from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document record extracted from the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the judgment or legal document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The legal cause of action or case type identified in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    case_records: list[CaseRecord]
